[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 15:50  
[FACT] User is a 32-year-old male.  
[FACT] User has a master's degree in data science from New York University.  
[FACT] User is trying to understand the green card application process, specifically the EB-2 visa category.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The EB-2 visa category is an employment-based, second-preference visa for foreign nationals who possess advanced degrees or exceptional abilities in their field.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To qualify for an EB-2 visa, the user must meet one of the following criteria: hold a U.S. master's degree or higher, or demonstrate exceptional ability in their field.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Required documents for the EB-2 visa application include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Petition: Form I-140, Immigrant Petition for Alien Worker, filed by the U.S. employer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Labor Certification: Obtained from the U.S. Department of Labor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Education and Experience: Documentation of advanced degree and relevant work experience.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Letters of Recommendation: From experts in the field attesting to exceptional abilities and achievements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Resume and CV: Detailed resume and curriculum vitae highlighting education, work experience, and achievements.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The EB-2 visa application process typically involves four steps:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Labor Certification: Employer files a labor certification application.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. I-140 Petition: Employer files Form I-140 with USCIS.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. I-485 Application: User files Form I-485 to adjust status or apply for an immigrant visa.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Interview and Approval: Attend an interview and receive the green card if approved.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Processing times for EB-2 visa applications can vary:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Labor certification: 6-9 months  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - I-140 petition: 3-6 months  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - I-485 application: 6-12 months  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fees associated with the EB-2 visa application process include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Labor certification: $0  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - I-140 petition: $700
